node.acceptance_condition: Brief contains one working definition of kitsch plus 3–5 distinct marks, each stated in one sentence with one or two sentences of plain-language explanation; no citations, no invented authorities; usable directly as criteria.
node.expected_contribution: The governing definition and test criteria for kitsch that the final essay applies to AI art.
node.objective: Produce a compact analytical brief (150–250 words of plain-prose notes, not an essay section) giving a working definition of kitsch for a general educated reader and extracting 3–5 explicit, applicable marks of kitsch — for example: pre-digested emotion, formula over risk, flattery of the viewer's existing taste, effect without effort. The criteria must be statable for any artifact regardless of how it was made, so the parent essay can apply them to AI-generated work.
node.rationale: A thesis about whether AI art is kitsch is only as strong as the standard it applies; this child fixes the evaluative vocabulary the synthesis will use.
